description: Read whether the site's authorization of one worker wallet on one job stands right now: authorized, withdrawn, no longer standing because its signer stopped speaking for the job's site, or none. A worker asks it to see whether the contractor's signature has landed; a contractor asks it to see that theirs did. It shows no note and no signer address. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

workerWallet.description: The 0x… address of the worker to read. Address only, never a private key.

name: site_authorization_status
title: Where a worker stands on a site authorization
